subject: POC environment onboarding — next steps & timeline
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@cloudhealth.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: POC environment onboarding — next steps & timeline

Hi Irene / Marissa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. We’re excited to move the POC forward. To avoid any surprises on our side, here’s a compact summary of the items CloudHealth needs your team to provision in the MAP for the evaluation:

- Org invite / role: please provision an org-scoped read/write API key for integration testing and invite one admin user for our EngOps team (engops@cloudhealth.ai).
- API key delivery: we prefer a short-lived key for the first two weeks, with rotation notes (how we rotate).
- IP allowlist: we’ll open inbound firewall rules to these egress IPs — 35.201.10.0/24 and 34.68.55.0/24 — can you confirm these are acceptable?
- VPC peering: we’ll need the peering template + expected AWS account ID and primary CIDR. We can accept a CIDR /24 for peering.

We’re aiming for a network-ready environment by the week of Dec 20 so we can run the integration smoke tests. Can you confirm an ETA for the org invite + API key and whether the IP ranges above look ok? I attached the one-page internal checklist we use on our side.

Attachments: cloudhealth-infra-reqs.pdf (stub)

Thanks —
Samira Khan
Director, Integrations
CloudHealth.ai
samira@cloudhealth.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@cloudhealth.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC environment onboarding — next steps & timeline

Hi Samira —

Great summary, thanks. I’m attaching our MAP checklist and a short mutual action timeline so everyone has the same expectations. Quick answers below and proposed next steps: 

1) Org invite: Irene, can you invite engops@cloudhealth.ai to a temporary org role (Org QA Admin)? We’ll document the exact scope in the checklist.
2) API key: We can issue a scoped API key with a 14-day TTL and token rotation instructions. We’ll push the key to a secure link (DocuSign/secure transfer) — prefer to do that after the kickoff call.
3) IP allowlist: 35.201.10.0/24 and 34.68.55.0/24 are OK from our side; Marcus will verify NAT egress ranges once he confirms the host pool.
4) VPC peering: see attached vpc-peering-template.yaml (starter). We need CloudHealth AWS account ID and primary CIDR.

Proposed kickoff: Mon, Dec 13 10:00 AM PT — 30 minutes (network + security + product). If that works, I’ll send calendar invites and an agenda.

Attachments: redwood-map-checklist.pdf (stub), vpc-peering-template.yaml (stub)

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Samira Khan <samira@cloudhealth.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC environment onboarding — next steps & timeline

Marissa —

All good on our side. Quick answers:
- AWS account ID: 702-849-001 (please treat this as sensitive).
- Primary CIDR for the test VPC: 10.40.0.0/16. We will allocate a /24 (10.40.5.0/24) for the peering connection.
- EngOps contact: engops@cloudhealth.ai (same as above) and Jose Ramirez (jose.ramirez@cloudhealth.ai) as backup.
- IP allowlist: we’ve already filed the firewall change with our networking team (ticket #CH-1987). Expected rollout: Dec 15 evening.

We’ll be on the kickoff call if scheduled. Attaching the internal network ticket export for reference.

Attachments: ch-1987-ticket-export.txt (stub)

Thanks —
Samira

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@cloudhealth.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC environment onboarding — next steps & timeline

Looping internal owners —

Marcus: please validate CloudHealth’s CIDR (10.40.5.0/24) against our peering policy and confirm the egress NAT ranges we’ll present to them. If we can accept that /24, add the config to the vpc-peering-template.yaml and return to me by EOD Mon (Dec 14).

Ben: please prepare a scoped API key flow (14-day TTL) and a secure delivery method; coordinate with Security on rotation docs. Hold issuance until after the kickoff call unless there’s an urgent need.

Marissa: go ahead and lock the Dec 13 10:00 AM PT kickoff with Samira and Jose — include Product, EngOps, and Networking. Add a 15-minute pre-call with our engineers (Ben + Marcus) at 9:30 AM PT to run the peering template live.

Samira — thanks for the ticket export; that rollout timeline (Dec 15) works for us. We’ll aim for a canary integration Dec 20 if everything is green. Also dropping a DocuSign SOW link below for procurement to sign; we’ll activiate dedicated billing upon signature.

DocuSign (SOW): https://www.docusign.com/transactions/ABCDEF-123456

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC environment onboarding — next steps & timeline

Samira —

Quick status update from engineering:
- Marcus confirmed the /24 (10.40.5.0/24) fits our peering rules; no overlap with Redwood VPC pools. I’ve attached the updated vpc-peering-template.yaml with the expected route tables and security-group hints.
- API key flow: we’ll generate a scoped key after the kickoff and send via a secure transfer link; rotation instructions included in the checklist.
- IP allowlist: we’ll provide our NAT egress set by Dec 14 EOD so you can finalize firewall changes on the 15th.

Next milestone (mutual action): network-ready + API key delivered by Dec 17 to allow integration smoke tests on Dec 20. If CloudHealth can confirm the peering acceptance window (we’re targeting Dec 16 preflight), we’ll prioritize that slot.

Onwards —
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
